teaser: A bookmarklet from my security days, a page API every site should publish, and six fixes running on this newsroom: the next UX is the user's own.
core_idea: Most sites are built for ads and attention, and readers could fix them in a line of code; if a site publishes a small JavaScript API of primitives, every fix is one line, tests and agents use the same surface, accessibility becomes each reader's to build, and the fixes people keep are the best brief the site will get; this newsroom now runs six such fixes.
